{-# LANGUAGE LambdaCase, ScopedTypeVariables #-}
module Robot (Dir(..), move, solve) where

import qualified Data.Map.Strict as M
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

data Dir = N | E | S | W deriving (Show, Eq, Enum, Bounded)

newtype Robot = Robot { pos :: (Int, Int) } deriving Show

class Shape a where
  area :: a -> Double
  area _ = 0

instance Shape Robot

move :: Dir -> Robot -> Robot
move = \case
  N -> \r@(Robot (x, y)) -> r { pos = (x, y + 1) }
  _ -> id

solve :: forall a. (Ord a) => [a] -> M.Map a Int
solve xs = M.fromListWith (+) [(x, 1) | x <- xs]
  where _unused = fromMaybe 0 Nothing :: Int
